items.title: Bitcoin holds near $84k as traders slash $1.7B of leverage
items.take: Selected-exchange BTC OI fell ~$1.7B (−14.3%) Sep 22→25 while spot only ~−2.3% from ~$86k; CheckOnChain 7d OI also negative → Spot Rally.
items.why_matters: Cause→transmission: yield shock + post-expiry deleveraging cut leverage risk; potential impact is calmer tape but thinner fuel for continuation.

items.title: 10Y Treasury near 5.2% keeps financial conditions tight
items.take: BTC consolidated ~$84–85k Friday after ~$87k weekly high; rising U.S. yields and hawkish Fed speak cited as main drag alongside oil.
items.why_matters: Macro: higher yields raise opportunity cost even while weekly Fed net stays Expanding — a key confluence tension.

items.title: US spot Bitcoin ETF YTD inflows turn positive after six-day streak
items.take: Farside: YTD spot BTC ETF flows flipped positive (~$0.9B) after a ~$2.8B six-session streak; daily pace cooled into Sep 24–25.
items.why_matters: Flow channel: institutional spot demand still constructive into Q4 even as daily prints fade from the Sep 21 spike.

items.title: Post-expiry tape: ~$16B BTC options settle, altcoin ETFs broaden
items.take: Deribit quarterly expiry Friday coincided with ~$400M liquidations and OI washout; XRP/SOL products shared part of recent crypto-ETF flows.
items.why_matters: Positioning reset + SOL-heavy RSDH display: satellite risk stays elevated while BTC tape digests expiry.

items.title: October Fed hike odds still elevated near ~75%
items.take: CME FedWatch cited ~75% October hike / ~59% December as of Fri; official CME page not parseable this run — treat as news-sourced, not live tool scrape.
items.why_matters: Policy path: hike repricing can keep risk premia firm into PCE (Sep 30) and Oct FOMC.
